storyboard_arc_title: Isla keeps the day from deciding for her

storyboard_arc.setup: Before the morning rush takes over, Isla sneaks in a few minutes with her puzzle grid.
storyboard_arc.disruption: Her train is running late, but she welcomes the delay as a cozy pocket of steady focus.
storyboard_arc.choice: Slipping into a sidewalk cafe, she flips her phone over to claim a few uninterrupted minutes.
storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Taking that extra moment pays off; the solution clicks and her busy day feels manageable again.
storyboard_arc.resolution: With one last glance, she shuts her screen, letting the steady rain wash away any lingering stress.

captions:
Better get this solved before the day gets too loud.
Before the morning rush takes over, Isla sneaks in a few minutes with her puzzle grid.

I don't mind the delay. It actually gives me some extra thinking time.
Her train is running late, but she welcomes the delay as a cozy pocket of steady focus.

Just three minutes to think. No notifications allowed.
Slipping into a sidewalk cafe, she flips her phone over to claim a few uninterrupted minutes.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

There we go. That feels right.
Taking that extra moment pays off; the solution clicks and her busy day feels manageable again.

Done. Time to just breathe and enjoy the afternoon.
With one last glance, she shuts her screen, letting the steady rain wash away any lingering stress.
